3:62.text: Verily! This is the true narrative
(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh, the One and the Only True God, Who has neither a wife nor a son)
. And indeed, Allâh is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

3:63.text: (and do not accept these true proofs and evidence)
, then surely, Allâh is All-Aware of those who do mischief.

3:64.text: : Come to a word that is just between us and you, that we worship none but Allâh
, and that we associate no partners with Him, and that none of us shall take others as lords besides Allâh
. Then, if they turn away, say: "Bear witness that we are Muslims."

3:65.text: ! Why do you dispute about Ibrâhîm
were not revealed till after him? Have you then no sense?

3:66.text: Verily, you are those who have disputed about that of which you have knowledge. Why do you then dispute concerning that of which you have no knowledge? It is Allâh Who knows, and you know not.

3:67.text: was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was a true Muslim Hanîfa
(Islâmic Monotheism - to worship none but Allâh Alone)
and he was not of Al-Mushrikûn

3:68.text: Verily, among mankind who have the best claim to Ibrâhîm
are those who followed him, and this Prophet

3:69.text: A party of the people of the Scripture
wish to lead you astray. But they shall not lead astray anyone except themselves, and they perceive not.

3:70.text: : "Why do you disbelieve in the Ayât of Allâh,
[the Verses about Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم present in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)]
